title: Scope Creep Request Intake
dataSources: Renovation tasks (`reno:task`), budget and receipts (`reno:budget`), material orders (`reno:material`), inspections (`reno:inspection`), contractor logs (`reno:contractor`).
app: Home-renovation project management — task boards (Trello, Notion), budget and receipt trackers, material orders, and inspection / permit logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reno:task scope_change=yes
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as scope_requests by _time room
| sort - _time
description: Measures how many new ideas or late asks are entering the plan after work is underway.
value: Scope creep is normal but costly; intake trendlines show when creativity turns into schedule risk.
implementation: Flag scope changes in `reno:task` and count them weekly by room.
visualization: Line chart of weekly scope-change requests by room.
grandmaExplanation: It spots how many extra ideas are being added after the renovation is already moving.
